Legal Studies Program
Political Science Department
The Legal Studies
Option
gives
students
an excellent opportunity to learn about
the law. The option's 4.0 credits provide a solid foundation in the social
scientific analysis of the legal system in Canada, in other countries, and
internationally. It is strongly recommended to students who are considering
pursuing law school or employment opportunities that require familiarity with
the law.
